queries.query: What are a director's duties under UK company law?
queries.ground_truth: A director of a company must act in the way he considers, in good faith, would be most likely to promote the success of the company for the benefit of its members as a whole.

queries.query: What constitutes unfair dismissal under UK employment law?
queries.ground_truth: An employee has the right not to be unfairly dismissed by his employer.

queries.query: How is personal data defined under UK data protection law?
queries.ground_truth: Personal data means any information relating to an identified or identifiable living individual.
